prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on growth: profit grew 52% compared with a year earlier. prose.against: The case against rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: free cash flow for the last financial year was negative: the business spent more than it generated. Also against it: return on capital employed is only 5.8%, a weak return on the money in the business; net debt is 6.3 times a year of operating earnings, heavy; and operating profit covers interest only 1.9 times, thin. Other areas on this side: the balance sheet, the quality of the business, the recent price trend.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 5 points in favour and 9 against give more points against. The pool score is 40 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet.
